name: Party ReStalk
source:
It's your partner's birthday tomorrow! You want to throw them a surprise party, but your partner's not the... easiest person to keep a secret from.

But that's not going to stop you! You'll just have to tell them a few white lies while you get everything else you'll need for their party. Surely this will work out in your favor... right?

[From [url=https://jazzbelle-dev.itch.io/party-restalk]itch.io[/url]]
